description: One eight-input OR gate, with the result offered both ways round.

inputs.text: One of the eight inputs; taking any one of them high changes both outputs.

outputs.text: 10V while A to H are all low, 0V as soon as any of them goes high.
10V while any of A to H is high, 0V while they are all low.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
